jobs.description: Software Engineer, AI-Enabled Services (GCP)Role Summary We are seeking a Software Engineer to build and ship production-ready AI-enabled services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Our agents and workflows are assembled in a low-code agent builder and n8n. This role focuses on the high-code layer underneath: MCP servers, APIs, and application services that give those agents and workflows secure, reliable access to enterprise systems and data.The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with a rigorous approach to quality and the ability to work directly with partners. You will translate business needs from technical and non-technical stakeholders into well-designed, well-tested services, and you will hold a high bar for what "production-ready" means. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain high-code services on GCP, including MCP servers, APIs, and supporting application services, using Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, and related capabilities. Build integrations with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and event streams that low-code agents and n8n workflows can use reliably. Own quality for the products you build: define test strategies, write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and establish release-readiness criteria. Validate the behavior of AI-enabled workflows, including tool invocation, error handling, edge cases, and regressions, and help define evaluation approaches for non-deterministic outputs. Design, develop, and manage relational database schemas, queries, migrations, and performance tuning in support of application and workflow needs. Meet with partners, both technical and non-technical, to gather requirements, clarify goals, and walk through designs. Translate their needs into clear technical specifications, and explain trade-offs, risks, and status in language each audience understands. Collaborate with architects, product managers, and domain experts to shape scalable solutions and set expectations on scope, timelines, and quality. Help define patterns and standards for service design, observability, testing, security, and operational support across our low-code and high-code environments. Implement strong engineering practices, including CI/CD, code reviews, monitoring, alerting, and infrastructure-as-code. Optimize solutions for performance, resilience, cost, and maintainability. Partner with security and platform teams to ensure compliant and secure handling of data, credentials, and enterprise integrations. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven experience as a software engineer building and supporting production-grade applications and services. Strong programming skills in one or more modern languages such as Python, TypeScript, or Java. Hands-on experience building and deploying services on Google Cloud Platform. Demonstrated QA discipline: experience with test automation, test planning, API and integration testing, and release validation for production systems. Strong experience with relational database development and management, including schema design, SQL, indexing, query optimization, and migrations. Experience developing and consuming REST APIs and working with event-driven architectures and distributed systems. Familiarity with containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Excellent communication skills , with a track record of gathering requirements and discussing design with both technical and non-technical partners, and of presenting technical concepts clearly to varied audiences. Ability to work across technical and functional teams in a fast-moving environment. Preferred Experience Experience building or consuming MCP servers or similar tool-integration layers for AI agents. Experience with low-code or workflow automation platforms such as n8n, and an understanding of how to build services that support them. Experience with NoSQL databases, vector stores, and analytical platforms. Exposure to AI-native applications, such as LLM-based workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, or tool use, including methods for evaluating and testing them. Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, middleware, and event streaming. Experience designing systems with observability, traceability, and human-in-the-loop controls. Understanding of AI application risks, including hallucination, security boundaries, governance, and responsible AI controls. Experience in enterprise environments where reliability, compliance, and scalability are critical. What Success Looks Like The services you ship are production-ready, thoroughly tested, and dependable, not experimental. Partners trust you: they feel heard during requirements discussions and understand the design decisions that follow. Low-code agents and n8n workflows can connect to enterprise systems through your MCP servers and services without surprises. You raise the quality bar for the team by establishing sound testing, release, and operational patterns. You balance speed with discipline, delivering solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. Example Areas of Work MCP servers and APIs that expose enterprise capabilities to low-code agents and n8n workflows Relational data services supporting approvals, case management, and workflow state Integrations between AI services and enterprise systems such as HR, IT, collaboration, and knowledge platforms Test automation, evaluation harnesses, and release-readiness checks for AI-enabled workflows Requirements and design sessions with business and technical partners 12 Yrs Python, MCP, Software engineering, GCP, Software
